g.text: ArthurRank5Convo4 begins.
Check boolean ArthurDating
Sweets, can I ask you something?
true
Chat ends.
false
Of course.
Can we chat later? [End.]
Everything you've told me of the future...
Chat ends.
Entrati.
The Man in the Wall.
The Sentients.
Tau.
Someday - and someday soon, I feel like the future will need you.
What're you trying to say?
I gtg. [End.]
I'm saying that sooner or later, you're going to go home and leave us here.
Chat ends.
Are you telling me to leave?
No. I'm saying that I feel like it's inevitable. Someday you *will* leave.
Travel isn't permanent. I can come and go.
Screw the future. I never belonged there.
Right. And someday you'll walk through that portal and never come back.
Are you telling me that if "The Lotus" came calling, you wouldn't go running?
Why're you so angry with me for no reason?
Says who?
You wouldn't charge off to save the universe again?
This is a valid concern.
Says common sense.
The future's in good hands. They don't need me. This place does.
I...yeah. I'm sorry. I'd have to go, if the universe was at stake.
Either you get sick of us and leave, or something horrible happens.
Common sense? Or fear?
This is asinine. [End.]
I don't want to leave, Arthur.
We need your help with what? Viktor Vodiyanoi? Please.
Honesty. Thank you.
Something horrible?
Thanks for the vote of confidence...
I repeat: Why are you angry at me for no reason?
I'm not afraid. I was fine before you. I'll be fine after you.
Chat ends.
So why are you pushing me away?
I've seen what the future's up against.
Would you come back?
You might die in the future, and I'd...never know.
I'm being serious.
So, what's the problem, exactly?
Hey look on the bright side, you'll be the best Excalibur again if I go.
I'm not.
I can handle some Techrot and some overzealous military goons.
I would fight tooth and nail to make it back to you.
Meh.
I just...I have this recurring nightmare of you...
No, you're not. You're looking for an excuse.
I'm not having an argument with you over something that isn't real. [End.]
Since I clearly don't matter to you.
Oh, *sod off.*
LOL
Then what the *hell* do you call this?
Fine. Then the truth is? Ironically, I can't predict the future.
I don't want to leave. So what do you want me to say?
My home is here, with you.
Update boolean ArthurDating
Laying in a puddle of blood on some distant planet, killed by some...alien robot, or mutated...whatever.
You want a reason to push me away. You want a reason to not have to *care.*
Chat ends.
That's not what I meant.
Chat ends.
I'm being serious.
This is called an adult conversation.
Then I'll ask again. If you get pulled away: would you come back?
I don't know.
But you're a soldier, like me. And sometimes soldiers don't come home.
Update boolean ArthurNoDate
And I wouldn't have been there to save you.
People die. People disappear. That's called *life.*
Do you want me to leave? Or stay?
What *did* you mean?
You could disappear at any time. You could get sick of us or die. And I'd never know.
No, this is called you looking for excuses.
I don't have any plans to leave. And that's the best I can do right now.
After this conversation? I'm thinking not.
If I could, of course. Why would you assume otherwise?
All right, let's start over. Can you tell me what's really bothering you?
Well, let me know when you figure it out. I'm done with this conversation. [End.]
Yeah. And that's just...how it goes, sometimes.
The good news is, I'm really hard to kill.
Update boolean IsDating
And before you claim "I promise I won't go," you're lying.
It happens to anyone, at any time. Nothing is ever certain.
I want you to stay.
First thing's first. You matter to me.
Stop looking for excuses.
So do you want me to stay? Or leave?
You don't want to get hurt, and I understand that. I respect that.
And that's supposed to be enough?
Update boolean ArthurDating
Too much time expecting the worst of people.
I just keep...having this nightmare, where you're gone.
Chat ends.
I'll hold onto the dream of retirement.
Heh. Yeah. I know.
Well. Better to find out this was a mistake *now* rather than *later.* I'm ending this between us.
Because I know you. And I know if you get that call, you're going. You'll do the right thing.
Whether or not they're freaks or from the future or not.
And I'm...worried someday you'll leave and...never come back.
Yeah. And it should be enough.
I...don't know.
But people disappear all the time. Normal people.
Update boolean ArthurNoDate
I'm jumping at shadows.
Where I couldn't save you.
I suppose it's hard to ever know how much time we have.
Chat ends.
That's who you are.
So stop making *excuses* and tell me what's *really* bothering you, Arthur.
Because I might be from the future, but I can't predict it, Arthur.
I think you don't want to get hurt.
Let me know when you figure it out. [End.]
People die all the time. Normal people.
Update boolean IsDating
And... I can't stand the thought of it.
+20 Chemistry
But the idea of it doesn't scare me. I'm not lying about that.
I don't know what the future holds for us.
Can you blame me?
Chat ends.
You don't have to be a freak or from the future for that to happen.
Well, better we end this now, rather than later, I suppose.
I...don't think anybody's ever worried about *me* before.
Remember, *I'm* the better fighter, here. I don't need saving.
Best to just...cherish what we've got.
Because whatever the thought of you dying does to me, it's somehow far, far worse than that.
But right now? I want to be here with you.
Of course not.
That doesn't mean I'm going to intentionally disappear.
So stop searching for reasons to push me away.
Chat ends.
That might be the...sweetest thing I've ever heard.
Yeah. Screw me for caring.
Chat ends.
I don't even know if it has a name.
But I think you need to figure out if you're okay with this relationship.
Intentionally.
If you want this to end, just end it. Don't blame it on me someday "disappearing."
Not that you're worried about me--I don't want that.
Chat ends.
Then I vow I will always fight tooth and nail to come back to you.
I...don't know what to say.
I can't do this to you. I can't. We need to end this now. [Break up with Arthur.]
Because yeah. Someday, something MIGHT happen.
Something might happen. I can't promise otherwise.
No...sorry.
But that you *care.*
That's the most I can ask for. And maybe take me with you if you ever find a way.
Just tell me you'll try not to die out there. Or at least take me with you if you ever find a way.
Update boolean ArthurDating
That's called life.
You're right.
I can't promise I'll always make it back alive.
I promise.
Update boolean IsDating
Sometimes, people don't come back.
I don't deal well when I'm the one trapped in the past and you're the one rushing off into battle to save the world.
But I can promise I'll fight tooth and nail every single time to do so.
+20 Chemistry
Update boolean ArthurNoDate
No kidding.
I'd feel the same in your shoes.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends.
I...yeah. You're right. This is for the best.
That's the most a soldier - and a man - can ask for. Thanks, sweets.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
